# Generated userscript output

`dist/S1Plus.user.js` is generated by `npm run build` and is intentionally not
committed during the modularization foundation phase.

The repository-root `S1Plus.js` remains the canonical installable userscript
until the modular source tree reaches behavior parity and the release workflow
is explicitly switched to the generated artifact.

Use `npm run verify:bundle` to build the bundle and verify its metadata,
runtime markers, ESM removal, and JavaScript syntax.
